title: Expire Alert
description:
Expire alerts individually or in bulk by providing their unique alert IDs. A successful request requires at least one valid ID, with a maximum limit of 100 IDs per bulk operation.

### Changelog


Added a new endpoint to expire alerts.

body.description: Expire up to 100 alerts by providing their unique IDs. At least one valid ID is required. Use the Get Alerts List endpoint to retrieve valid IDs.
